g.text: C-101 OVERHEAD SYSTEM & REFLUX DRUM D-102
1. Neutraliser and filming amine injected upstream of A-101; pH control AIC-1037 trims FFIC-1036.
2. PIC-1032 split range: 0-50 % PV-1032B (FG make-up) closing, 50-100 % PV-1032A (off-gas) opening.
3. SIF-109 initiator / final element per SRS: LT-1033B high-high closes XV-1034 (see data issue log).
4. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
5. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
6. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
1667 m2 bare; 3 bay(s) 6 m x 12 m, 6 fans
MAT'L CS tubes, Al fins (A-101: CS + inlet ferrules, Ti
SHELL: OH vapour/condensate / TUBE: Cooling water
ID 3.4 m x 12.0 m T/T; boot ID 1.5 m x 3.0 m
